text: Two HIGH defects in the lane's own diff, neither found by four rounds of the author's own mutation testing, because every one of those mutations lived INSIDE the class while both defects lived in the wiring and the transport above it. A discipline can be correct, documented and unit-tested and still be void because the thing that calls it does not honour its contract.

what: _send_quarantine_alarm returned None on every path, so confirm_sent ran even when Telegram refused the page: an undelivered page consumed the hour-long suppression window. The decide/confirm_sent split, documented and unit-tested, was voided by the wiring one layer up where the class's own tests cannot see.
cure: helper returns bool, caller gates on it, plus a guilt/innocence test pair; the three mutations named by the gate (delete the send, delete confirm_sent, force page=None) each now die to a named test

what: The page interpolated reasons and identifiers unescaped while send_telegram_message hardcodes parse_mode=Markdown. All four quarantine_reason values contain an underscore, order_id usually does, and the sample line wrapped the order in square brackets which are reserved too. Telegram answers 400 can't parse entities and that function treats 4xx as NON-retryable, so the page is dropped permanently. The alarm built to cure 'nobody reads this state' would have delivered nothing.
cure: reused the pattern this subsystem had already established and this module failed to reuse (outbox_handlers._escape_markdown / _render_id): ids in backtick code spans with backticks stripped to a visible marker, free text escaped, brackets removed; two tests, mutation-proved by making the escaper a no-op

what: garuda_payment_inbox.order_id is never written by any path, so the page reported 'no matching order' even for amount_mismatch and unexpected_state where the repository had just found the order — a false statement in an alert.
cure: the false wording was removed immediately (the page now says only what is true); the missing write is ledgered REQUIRED, because writing a new column from five call sites on a money path is a writer change with its own blast radius

what: The guilt/innocence pair monkeypatches _send_quarantine_alarm itself, so it proves the scheduler honours the answer but nothing about the answer: a regression returning True on a Telegram refusal would leave both tests green.
cure: parametrized test of the REAL helper with only the notifier replaced, covering missing credentials, (False, err) including the 400 case, and (True, None)

what: The PII test proves less than its name: it asserts the poisoned identifiers DO reach the message. Corrected an earlier docstring fix of the author's that called provider_event_id 'provider-opaque' — that column is TEXT with no format CHECK, so nothing in this repo structurally prevents PII-shaped text arriving in it; what holds is a property of the provider, not a guarantee we enforce.
cure: docstring now separates the two identifiers and says which guarantee is structural and which is the provider's

what: The quarantine reader is constructed only after build_handlers, so an unrelated failure building the outbox's email/portal handlers takes the watcher down and restores the original disease.
test_every_reason_the_repository_writes_is_accepted never consults the repository; it retypes the migration's four values, so it cannot catch the drift it is named for.
recent/lifetime, sample and reasons are read by three independent SELECTs with no common transactional snapshot, so a concurrent quarantine can briefly render an internally inconsistent message.

A quarantined row with NULL processed_at is counted in lifetime but excluded from recent, so it would page never while inflating the total forever. Unreachable today because all five writers set it in the same UPDATE, but the guarantee rests on writer convention rather than structure.

Validating CHECK plus non-concurrent CREATE INDEX inside the runner's single transaction — a pattern objection on a table that goes hot after the GARUDA_PUBLIC_ENABLED flip, not a live risk at current size.

An order in 'created' records session_not_bound for a PAID event but unexpected_state for failure/refund events, so one root cause wears two labels and blunts the reason-to-cure mapping the column exists for.

text: BOTH seats confirm the author's own dissent rather than dissolving it, and both traced the concrete Friday-night timeline independently. Kimi: the mitigations are honest but 'the window is a proxy for un-acknowledged' is a rationalisation AS A FINAL ANSWER, because the quiet notice fires once and an unhandled quarantine is then silent indefinitely. Codex: the window measures AGE and nothing else, and if the process restarts after the age-out not even the quiet notice fires, because a fresh alarm ignores lifetime>0 when recent==0. Both call the author's defence (unwindowed pages forever and gets muted) a FALSE DICHOTOMY and independently name the same third option, which needs no schema change and no acknowledgement column: a second, much longer stale timer keyed on lifetime, which already travels in every snapshot. Codex adds the honest limit neither the window nor the digest removes — stopping the alarm CORRECTLY after a human acts still requires durable acknowledgement state. Ledgered REQUIRED, not built here: it is a real scope expansion on a diff that had already grown twice.

Both seats reject the author's self-raised scope-creep dissent: the persisted reason, the CHECK, the index and the reader are one observable chain, and splitting leaves one half temporarily incomplete. The Gear-3 gate added the argument neither seat nor the author had made — splitting means touching the same five call sites twice, so the 'smaller' PR is MORE total churn on a money path.

topic: process — a contaminated seat is a silent failure
text: The FIRST codex-gpt-5.6-sol run of this council produced no findings and was contaminated BY THE BUILD LANE: it was reading the LIVE worktree while the lane edited the same files in response to the kimi finding. The seat noticed, said so explicitly, adapted — and then ended on tool calls without emitting a verdict, exit code 0 with zero output. Green does not mean working, in the review layer itself. It was re-dispatched against a diff frozen at 1179237c1665 and delivered in full. Recorded because the failure mode is silent and generalises: dispatch review seats against a frozen artifact, never a live worktree.

Both ok:true lines describe seats that genuinely delivered findings. The first codex run is recorded above as a process failure and deliberately carries NO ok:true line of its own. Writing one would have cleared the very check that exists to prove a council happened, which is the reward-hacking this gate exists to stop; a council of two that really ran beats a council of three where one line was written by the author.
